objectives.text: Count a group of up to 10 real objects by pointing to each one in order
Combine two physical groups of objects to make a single bigger group
Count all the objects in the combined group to find the total sum up to 5
Identify the plus sign and equals sign as symbols that help us write number stories
Count groups of physical objects placed in sets of five to find the total amount
Identify the number pattern of ending digits alternating between 0 and 5 on a hundred chart
Explain how counting by 5s is a shortcut for counting by 1s
Demonstrate bundling ten single blocks into one ten-rod using physical counters
Explain why we move an extra ten over to the tens column when our ones add up to 10 or more
Solve two-digit addition equations that require regrouping the ones
